title: Census deterministic 1: measured baseline, one driver, phase-2 bookkeeping by tool
goal: census.py records each phase's wall time, rows and reading volume and prints the phase-2 reading queue's size and estimated tokens before any reading; census.py run and finish carry phases 0, 1 and 3 with no agent turn between their steps; census.py groups, brief and apply group the phase-2 rows, print each group's filled brief with its review passages and cited facts, and apply a group's JSON result (new source rows, superseded_by, gap and conflict bullets, outcomes, re-anchoring, index) with a dry run; the kb-census skill drives the census through those commands.
